notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
This free update brings improvements to almost all aspects of the game and adds a brand new mode.

Some of the things updated are:

-New mode: Linear Mode, survive as long as you can on a very wide, linear map filled with obstacles.

-Ship controls are slightly more responsive.
-A few obstacles have been adjusted.
-Improved visibility of powerups.
-Remade menus.
-Improved graphics and lighting.
-Fixed some bugs.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33088302/fa2d339680186e9ce6f3fa8ac693f33839d98162.png[/img]


-Added rebindable keys for gamepad, if you had custom keybinds they will be reset.

-New mode: narrow mode, get as far as you can on a narrow track with no walls.


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: DriftForce is here!
notes.content:
[h1] DriftForce is now available on steam!	[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33088302/55cdf5459cbf910ffc4ffb23114fb5b68c96d4fd.png[/img]


After what feels like an eternity, i am happy to finally release DriftForce!

My plan for the coming weeks is to release a few free updates with new modes etc.

If you have any technical problems please contact me or let me know in the community hub.
